subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

I am in a difficult __predicament__ as I have two offers at a time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Dilemma**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**predicament**' is '**dilemma**'.
 
• **Predicament**: an unpleasant and difficult situation that is hard to get out of. (अप्रिय और कठिन स्थिति जिससे बाहर निकलना कठिन हो)
 
 
• *Example: He must use it wisely if his club is to escape their current **predicament**.*
 
 
 
• **Dilemma**: a situation in which you have to make a difficult choice between two or more things. (दो या अधिक वस्तुओं में से एक का चयन करने की कठिन स्थिति, दुविधा, असमंजस)
 
 
• *Example: Doctors face a moral **dilemma** of when to keep patients alive artificially and when to let them die.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Dilemma.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Success**: the fact that you have achieved what you want; doing well and becoming famous, rich, etc. (अभीष्‍ट की प्राप्ति हो जाने की स्थिति; यश, धन आदि की प्राप्ति, सफलता, कामयाबी)
 
• **Offer**: to ask if somebody would like something or to give somebody the chance to have something. (किसी को कोई वस्‍तु पेश करना या उसे कोई वस्‍तु लेने का अवसर देना)
 
• **Advantage**: something that may help you to do better than other people. (लाभ या फ़ायदे की स्थिति)
